title: Pin the playtest summary and policy-lifetime tests
description: Follow-up from TASK-1.6 (doc-15): the judge's J-1-01 (MEDIUM) and code review found that no test checks a real 'Largest pot' value — two mutants survive (last hand's pot instead of the max; summing the pot index instead of the amount). Also untested: each seat's policy is created once per hand. src/playtest is not covered by the headless-boundary lint.

nodes.title: Pin the playtest summary and policy-lifetime tests
Bootstrap the strict TypeScript project with one-command checks
Rank showdown hands by real poker hand rankings
Deal every hand from a seeded shuffle with a replay code
Play a complete fixed-limit hand from blinds to showdown
Give each deciding seat only its own view of the hand
Run seeded bot-only hands from the command line
Run every check in GitHub Actions on each push and pull request

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a playtest summary over at least two hands where the larger pot comes first, When summarize runs, Then Largest pot equals the largest per-hand sum of award amounts
Given a real multi-hand run, When the report is built, Then the Largest pot line matches an independent recomputation from the played hands
Given a hand with several decisions per seat, When the runner plays it, Then each seat's policy is created exactly once for that hand
Given src/playtest imports a UI or browser module, When npm run lint runs, Then the headless-boundary rule fails naming the file
Given src/table imports a UI or browser module, When npm run lint runs, Then the headless-boundary rule fails naming the file, and the TASK-3.1 import-scan test (SPEC-10) is removed
